why: The answer correctly links the empty args array to the index args[0] being out of bounds, which explains the run-time crash for this case; it does not generalise to a class of inputs or to changed code.

concepts.quote: because args is empty and args[0] is out of bounds
concepts.why: Links having no typed arguments to there being no valid index 0 in args.
Correctly places the failure at run time, while java Twice executes.
Index 0 is not in the range 0..length-1 when the length is 0, so the access throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException.

concepts.quote: args is empty and args[0] is out of bounds
concepts.why: Matches the rule that with no arguments even args[0] is out of bounds.
